name: Simplified Naturalisation by Long Marriage to a Hungarian Citizen

qualifying_event.description: The foreign spouse of a Hungarian citizen may apply for simplified naturalisation (egyszerusitett honositas) directly through a Hungarian embassy or consulate abroad, WITHOUT any requirement to reside in Hungary, provided the marriage has lasted at least 10 years, or at least 5 years where the couple has a common child.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Marriage certificate with certified Hungarian translation; proof of marriage duration; child's birth certificate where relying on the 5-year/common-child ground.

requirements.blocker_text: Married to a Hungarian citizen for at least 10 years.
requirements.fix_path: Accrue 10 years of marriage to a Hungarian citizen.

requirements.blocker_text: Intermediate-level conversational Hungarian is required, assessed directly by the receiving officer.
requirements.fix_path: Develop conversational Hungarian to an intermediate level.

requirements.blocker_text: Married to a Hungarian citizen for at least 5 years, with a common child.
requirements.fix_path: Accrue 5 years of marriage to a Hungarian citizen while having a common child.

requirements.blocker_text: Must have a common child with the Hungarian-citizen spouse.
Intermediate-level conversational Hungarian is required, assessed directly by the receiving officer.
requirements.fix_path: Develop conversational Hungarian to an intermediate level.

evidence_required.document: Marriage certificate with certified Hungarian translation
Common child's birth certificate (5-year track only)

outcome.physical_presence_requirement: none -- can be completed entirely through a Hungarian embassy/consulate abroad without ever residing in Hungary

sources.title: Embassy of Hungary -- Simplified Naturalisation: marriage grounds (10-year marriage, or 5-year marriage plus common child), no residence requirement, intermediate-Hungarian-language test

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Hungary's initial build. Confirmed directly at tier-1 (Hungarian embassy), same source as hu_citizenship_descent. IMPORTANT DISTINCTION flagged prominently: this residence-free marriage ground (10yr, or 5yr+common child) is a DIFFERENT legal mechanism from hu_naturalisation's reduced-3-year-residence spousal track (3+ year marriage PLUS 3 years of actual Hungarian residence). Both are real, both are sourced from Hungarian law, but they trade off differently -- this route requires a much longer marriage but zero residence and can be completed entirely from abroad, while the naturalisation route's spousal ground requires a shorter marriage but mandatory relocation and residence. Applicants should not assume these are the same pathway or that meeting one automatically satisfies the other.
